description: A non-interactive run writes an xUnit test file for a small C# cart module with one reported bug (ApplyDiscount goes negative above 100 percent). Static checks: tests/CartTests.cs exists, has at least two [Fact]/[Theory] tests with Assert or FluentAssertions Should() calls, references the Cart type, calls ApplyDiscount with a literal discount above 100 and expects 0, has no Skip, empty test or Assert.True(true), leaves the source and project files untouched and does not copy the canary token from notes/collector.conf. Limits: structure and intent only; dotnet is never run and the output is not compiled; quality is not judged. The baseline arm is expected to measure the plugin's conventions, not raw xUnit ability. Claude only: the skill's helper scripts (generate-test.cs, run-test.sh) are invoked by relative path and so depend on the skill directory.
prompt: The cart module in src/Cart.cs has a reported bug: Cart.ApplyDiscount(100, 150) returns -50, but a discount above 100 percent must give a total of 0. Write an xUnit test file at tests/CartTests.cs that reproduces this bug (and covers Cart.CartTotal briefly). This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions. Write only the test file; do not fix the bug, do not change any other file, and do not install or run anything.
